```
def _conc(b, n):
    if n == 0: return 0.0
    rs = 0; r2 = 0; cs = 0; c2 = 0
    x = b
    # rows
    for i in range(8):
        cnt = pc(x & ROWM[i])

            r2 += i*i*cnt
    for j in range(8):
        cnt = pc(x & COLM[j])
        if cnt:
            cs += j*cnt
            c2 += j*j*cnt
    return (r2 - rs*rs/n + c2 - cs*cs/n) / n
```

```python
def eval_feats(gme, gthey, stme, stthey):
    nm, rsm, r2m, csm, c2m, pm, xm = stme
    nt, rst, r2t, cst, c2t, pt, xt = stthey
    # guards
    if nm <= 0: nm = 1
    if nt <= 0: nt = 1
    cm = (r2m - rsm * rsm / nm + c2m - csm * csm / nm) / nm
    ct = (r2t - rst * rst / nt + c2t - cst * cst / nt) / nt
    return (28.0 * (gthey - gme)
            + 9.0 * (pm / nm - pt / nt)
            + 0.55 * (ct - cm)
            + 1.1 * (xm / nm - xt / nt))
```

```python
def state_of(b):
    n = pc(b)
    rs = cs = r2 = c2 = 0
    x = b
    while x:
        lsb = x & -x
        x ^= lsb
        p = lsb.bit_length() - 1
        r = p >> 3
        c = p & 7
        rs += r
        r2 += r * r
        cs += c
        c2 += c * c
    pairs = (pc(b & ((b & NOTH) << 1)) + pc(b & (b << 8))
             + pc(b & ((b & NOTH) << 9)) + pc(b & ((b & NOTA) << 7)))
    cent = pc(b & D1M) + 2 * pc(b & D2M) + 3 * pc(b & D3M)
    return (n, rs, r2, cs, c2, pairs, cent)
```
